plainText:
Ayumi Kida (Japanese: 喜田あゆ美 Kida Ayumi) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Kida was born on June 7, 1966, in , . She started work on the in , where she voiced recurring character Sima, who is 's mother. She is currently affiliated with the talent agency Mouse Promotion.
